item.title: AI Agent Framework Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
On 2026-11-21, LangChain’s Python repository had the most GitHub stars of the 15 repositories we checked: 149,999. Its Python package also had the most PyPI downloads: 156,992,126 in the last month. The Claude Agent SDK’s TypeScript package had the most npm downloads: 80,627,825. Download counts show installs, not how many agents run in production.

These numbers were pulled by aiagentmemory.org on 2026-11-21 from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. The table is the script’s output, pasted without edits. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. For how each framework handles memory, read AI agent framework comparison.

item.title: MCP Server Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
On 2026-11-21, the MCP reference servers repository had the most GitHub stars of the 9 servers and SDKs we checked: 92,140. The MCP TypeScript SDK had the most npm downloads of that group: 385,658,740 in the last month. The MCP Python SDK had the most PyPI downloads: 330,822,908. The SDK numbers are high because many other tools depend on them, so they count installs, not people running a server.

We also checked 4 memory projects that ship an MCP server. They are in a second table, because a memory library and an MCP server are different kinds of project, and their download counts measure different things.

item.title: Vector Database Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
On 2026-11-21, Milvus had the most GitHub stars of the 8 vector databases we checked: 46,711. The pgvector Python package had the most PyPI downloads: 43,629,382 in the last month. Pinecone’s npm package had the most npm downloads: 4,830,781. Downloads count installs of a client package, not servers running in production.

These numbers were pulled by aiagentmemory.org on 2026-11-21 from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. The table is the script’s output, pasted without edits. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. For how these databases fit into agent memory, read best in-memory vector databases and vector databases for LLM memory.

item.title: AI Coding Agent Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
OpenClaw has the most GitHub stars of 12 AI coding agents we checked: 394,915 on 2026-11-20. Codex CLI has the most npm downloads: 115,733,979 in the last month. Stars show interest, not how well an agent works, and downloads count installs, not active users.

These numbers were pulled by aiagentmemory.org on 2026-11-20 from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. The table is the script’s output, pasted without edits. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. Memory data for the same tools is on Claude Code memory and Codex memory.
